description: Retrieve yearly citation counts and summaries for Scopus documents. Supply one native document identifier type, with comma-separated values for multiple documents. Returns the original Elsevier JSON in one request. Citation Overview access must be enabled for your API key.

author_id.description: Comma-separated author IDs whose citations should be excluded. Ignored when citation is exclude-books.

citation.description: Exclude self-citations or book citations; Elsevier includes all citations when omitted.

count.description: Maximum number of results. Elsevier determines the default and maximum from your API service level.

date.description: Year or inclusive year range for citation counts, e.g. 2024 or 2020-2024.

doi.description: One or more comma-separated DOIs. Supply exactly one document identifier type.

field.description: Comma-separated native response fields to include. Omit to use the full STANDARD view.

pii.description: One or more comma-separated publication item identifiers. Supply exactly one document identifier type.

pubmed_id.description: One or more comma-separated PubMed IDs. Supply exactly one document identifier type.

reqId.description: Caller-supplied request identifier for tracing this request with Elsevier support.

scopus_id.description: One or more comma-separated Scopus document IDs. Supply exactly one document identifier type.

sort.description: One sort field: sort-year or rowTotal. Prefix with + for ascending or - for descending; no prefix means ascending.

start.description: Zero-based result offset; Elsevier defaults to zero when omitted.

view.description: Citation Overview supports only the STANDARD view.
